name: cosmabot-connectors
description: Operational CosmaBot connectors and bot handoffs through the authenticated product API.

interface.shortDescription: Connected sources, private team drafts and recovery.
interface.longDescription: Calls configured first-party CosmaBot operations using current sign-in and server grants. Elation appointment, problem, medication, and lab tools, and Athena appointment, medication, allergy, and visit-link tools, are read-only and say when that record system is not connected or a read is not supported. Atlas.md read tools say this read is not supported yet and do not call Atlas.md. Human review and destination approval remain in CosmaBot.
defaultPrompt: Reopen my saved encounter and show each bot's handoff progress.
